predecessor.entry_rule: section 7.3: the 5,000-row train width effect held in all three seeds; the 1,000-row records are reached through the 5,000-row contract

control.reason: the R2-0B runs keep only the T-val selected checkpoint and the validation curve (selected steps 126 / 84 / 84), not the last-step state and train fit the D1 train reading needs; both arms are trained here in the same environment and sources
control.use: reference only: the new narrow runs are compared with the R2-0B runs of the same seed (evaluation curve, selected step and objective, H-dev primary) and reported; never a gate

widen.init: conv channel 0 and BatchNorm channel 0 copied from c5; new conv channels kaiming_normal_(fan_out, relu) from a dedicated generator; new channels input columns of the first Linear exactly 0; every other value-head tensor copied
widen.parents: rebuilt with the same construction and init seeds; each parent state SHA-256 must equal the one in the 1,000-row and 5,000-row prepare records

data.source: the c8 cycle cache train split (labels and splits of the A1 reference record)
data.recorded_at_prepare: game count and game-id SHA-256, composition, exact and D4 floors

budget.note: ceil(2 x 35,816 / 1,024) = 70 steps per epoch, 3.0 epochs: the c8 config itself, as R2-0B

pairing.per_seed: narrow and wide of a seed: the same data assignment (cycle rows, replay draw, augmentation), the same evaluation steps, the same approved HEAD, sources and runtime environment (recorded per run)

ruling.train_fit: section 4: per arm and seed the last-step W <= floor_d4 + margin is a fit; the first of WIDTH_EFFECT (W_wide - W_narrow < 0 for all three seeds, each larger than the narrow seed range), BOTH_FIT (all six fit), SEED_DISAGREEMENT (signs differ or zero), NEITHER_FIT (none fits), MIXED_FIT (hybrid.h7r_d1.fit_reading); committed before any H-dev prediction
ruling.hdev: R2 section 7 unchanged: I_s = L(narrow_s) - L(wide_s) > epsilon and the paired 95% upper bound of L(wide_s) - L(narrow_s) below 0 for all three seeds; the narrow seed range above epsilon holds
ruling.scope: a full-scale diagnosis: no D4 candidate by itself; a DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL here opens a separate D4 contract, nothing else

reference.c5: wide - c5 and narrow - c5, reported and never ruled
reference.components: outcome / proof macro and pooled differences without epsilon
reference.note: the H-dev reading uses the T-val selected checkpoints; the train-fit reading uses the last-step states; they are recorded apart and never mixed
reference.scale: each training row is seen about 3 times here, about 19 at 5,000 rows and about 105 at 1,000 rows: differences between the stages are not read as the effect of the data size alone

evaluate.write_order: predictions .partial, predictions record, link, result (the 1,000-row amendment A1)
evaluate.head_check: HEAD and the tracked tree re-checked right before the result is written

next.d4: only if the full-scale H-dev reading is DEVELOPMENT_SIGNAL: a separate D4 contract (move-selection quality); earlier D4 and X1 found that a prediction gain did not carry over to move selection
